'''Vosca Si'non''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:P25" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she stayed in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:P25" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Next, you need to visit Vosca Si'non and give her a nutrient injection.|[[2-1b-58|Billingsly]]|<ref name="stf">{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash; profession_medic_11.stf</ref>}}
[[File:TemplateCommonerFemale.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Vosca Si'non]]
Vosca Si'non was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P25" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vosca Si'non was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> During each server reset, Vosca Si'non's appearance was randomized, but she consistently appeared as a female.<ref name="SWG:P25" />

Vosca Si'non was intended to be part of the quest "[[W:c:swg:Caught in the Crossfire|Caught in the Crossfire]]," a low-level quest for players of the [[W:c:swg:Medic|Medic profession]].<ref name="stf" /> In this quest, the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] [[2-1b-58|Billingsly]] tasked the player to rescue several commoners in Mos Eisley, including [[Escara Frei]] and [[Jorund Redd]], who had been injured during a firefight between [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian's]] [[Valarian Syndicate|guards]] and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|thugs]].<ref name="SWG:CitC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Medic|Caught in the Crossfire|Tatooine}}</ref> Vosca Si'non was supposed to be the third person to rescue during the quest.<ref name="stf" /> However, while the character of Vosca Si'non was integrated into the game,<ref name="SWG:P25" /> the part of the quest involving this character was never activated.<ref name="stf" /> Vosca Si'non had therefore no role in the game and interacting with her did not start a conversation.<ref name="SWG:P25" />
